response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT ordertune, execution_count, execution_count * 1.0 / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(execution_count) AS total_executions, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - threshold.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN threshold WHERE share > threshold.average_share;
